offering_description.value: Provides outpatient mental health care, including psychiatry, therapy and psychological testing, to children, adolescents and adults. Care is delivered by employed clinicians through a network of physical centers and virtual telehealth visits, billed mainly to commercial health insurers.

primary_services.value: psychiatric evaluation and medication management; individual, couples, family and group therapy; psychological testing; telehealth mental health visits

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients seeking outpatient mental health care, children through adults; B2B: commercial health insurers and payers reimbursing care; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs

end_markets.value: behavioral health; outpatient mental health care; healthcare

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: payments from commercial insurers, Medicare and Medicaid for clinical visits; service fees: self-pay patients paying for visits

value_chain_position.value: service provider: employs psychiatrists, psychologists and therapists who deliver care to patients; asset operator: operates leased outpatient centers plus a virtual care platform

geography_served.value: US national: Centers across about 33 states, plus telehealth within those states

specialization.value: niche specialist: outpatient mental health care including psychiatry, therapy and testing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated outpatient mental health centers; online: virtual telehealth visits and online appointment booking

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed clinicians and practices, HIPAA, Medicare/Medicaid rules, state licensing and corporate practice of medicine laws
